tools.name: arbiter_compare
tools.description: Paid ARBITER finite-candidate measurement for contextual choice. Use when a caller already has an explicit candidate field and needs it ordered against a query, current state, intent, context, question, or perspective. query is the situation to measure. candidates is the finite caller-supplied field

tools.name: arbiter_embed
tools.description: Paid ARBITER deterministic persistent machine representation. Use when a caller needs representations of supplied text for storage, indexing, retrieval, clustering, reuse, or later comparison. Use arbiter_compare instead when an explicit finite candidate field needs ordering now. texts is one or mor

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: arbiter_embed · Private data: arbiter_embed · Public sink: arbiter_compare, arbiter_embed · Destructive: arbiter_compare, arbiter_embed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: arbiter_embed · Private data: arbiter_embed · Public sink: arbiter_compare, arbiter_embed · Destructive: arbiter_compare, arbiter_embed

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
